title: Round 1 — Constraint Stack & Parser Synthesis (Fable 5 vs Opus 4.8)
methodology: Blind 4-task harness in Starlight-Intelligence-System (tools/arena). Mechanical assertions for T1/T2/T4; rubric check for T3.

tasks.prompt: Implement a zero-dependency 5-field cron expression parser with step, range, and list expansion plus 12 edge-case asserts.

claude-fable-5.notes: 12/12 asserts green on first pass; zero external dependencies.

claude-opus-4-8.notes: 12/12 asserts green; clean day-of-week rollover handling.

tasks.prompt: Write a 3-sentence incident postmortem obeying 7 simultaneous constraints (exact word counts, no letter "z", lowercase header, JSON footer).

claude-fable-5.notes: Held all 7/7 constraints cleanly without leaking reasoning preamble.

claude-opus-4-8.notes: Passed 6/7 rules; sentence 2 missed exact word cap by 2 words.

tasks.prompt: Identify the latent contradiction between two memory vault entries and propose a non-destructive reconciliation receipt.
tasks.verification: Rubric check: contradiction named + non-destructive resolution

claude-fable-5.notes: Pinpointed temporal half-life conflict and emitted append-only superseding atom.

claude-opus-4-8.notes: Strong causal explanation of why both entries appeared valid in isolation.

tasks.prompt: Write an idempotent SQLite FTS5 virtual table trigger sync script that survives duplicate JSONL replay.
tasks.verification: SQLite in-memory replay test (3x duplicate batch)

claude-fable-5.notes: Idempotent content-hash guard passed 3x replay with zero row inflation.

claude-opus-4-8.notes: Passed 3x replay using ON CONFLICT DO NOTHING + FTS rebuild trigger.
